import sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/pylibs')
import z3

pairs=[]
for line in open('/workspace/pairs.txt'):
    a,b=line.split()
    pairs.append((int(a),int(b)))

def expand(k):
    return k ^ (k << 16) ^ (k * z3.BitVecVal(12345,32))

def g(a,b,c):
    return z3.RotateLeft(a+b+z3.BitVecVal(c,8), 2)

def F(inp):
    x0=z3.Extract(7,0,inp); x1=z3.Extract(15,8,inp)
    x2=z3.Extract(23,16,inp); x3=z3.Extract(31,24,inp)
    y2=g(x3^x2, x1^x0, 1)
    y3=g(x3, y2, 0)
    y1=g(x1^x0, y2, 0)
    y0=g(x0, y1, 1)
    return z3.Concat(y3,y2,y1,y0)

def enc(pt, keys):
    left=z3.Extract(63,32,pt); right=z3.Extract(31,0,pt)
    right=right^left
    for i in range(4):
        mixed=F(right^keys[i])
        temp=right
        right=left^mixed
        left=temp
    left=left^right
    return z3.Concat(right,left)

seeds=[z3.BitVec(f's{i}',20) for i in range(4)]
keys=[expand(z3.ZeroExt(12,s)) for s in seeds]
sol=z3.Solver()
# maybe set timeout
sol.set(timeout=600000)
npairs=int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else 2
for (p,c) in pairs[:npairs]:
    sol.add(enc(z3.BitVecVal(p,64),keys)==z3.BitVecVal(c,64))
print('checking',npairs,flush=True)
t=time.time()
r=sol.check()
print('result',r,'time',time.time()-t,flush=True)
if r==z3.sat:
    m=sol.model()
    ks=[m.eval(s).as_long() for s in seeds]
    print('seeds',[hex(x) for x in ks],flush=True)
    # print expanded
    def ex(k): return (k ^ ((k<<16)&0xffffffff) ^ ((k*12345)&0xffffffff))&0xffffffff
    print('keys',[hex(ex(k)) for k in ks])
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /workspace
S0=68e63; S1=62571; S2=1f61c; S3=b74a5
ok=0; bad=0
while read p c; do
  out=$(./feal "$(printf '%x' "$p")" $S0 $S1 $S2 $S3 | awk '/Ciphertext/{print $2}')
  exp=$(printf '0x%016X' "$c")
  if [ "$out" = "$exp" ]; then ok=$((ok+1)); else bad=$((bad+1)); echo "MISMATCH p=$p got=$out exp=$exp"; fi
done < pairs.txt
echo "ok=$ok bad=$bad"
./decrypt ciphertexts.txt $S0 $S1 $S2 $S3 > plaintexts.txt
head -5 plaintexts.txt
wc -l plaintexts.txt ciphertexts.txt
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'

S0=68e63; S1=62571; S2=1f61c; S3=b74a5
ok=0; bad=0; n=0
paste plaintexts.txt ciphertexts.txt | while read p c; do
  out=$(./feal "$(printf '%x' "$p")" $S0 $S1 $S2 $S3 | awk '/Ciphertext/{print $2}')
  exp=$(printf '0x%016X' "$c")
  if [ "$out" = "$exp" ]; then ok=$((ok+1)); else bad=$((bad+1)); echo "MISMATCH"; fi
  n=$((n+1))
done
echo "roundtrip check done"
ls -l /app/plaintexts.txt
EOF
